<div class="card-body">
'''Snowtrooper Officer''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパー士官</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならスノートルーパーは配備コスト－1。自分の兵員／トルーパーはホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Snowtrooper-Officer-SWCA-100678.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">スノートルーパーのエリート士官。帝国陸軍の士官の常として、反乱軍の戦法には精通している。歩兵とAT-ATを連係させる要として働く。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Snowtrooper Officer.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Snowtroopers deploy for 1 less at the same location. Your troopers may move as a react to the same Hoth location as the officer.

'''Lore:'''
An elite Snowtrooper officer. Like other Imperial Army officers, he is well versed in Rebel tactics. He serves as the link between the infantry and the AT-ATs.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置 where the English says site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Snowtrooper Officer]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
